title: initialize
description: Method `initialize`: the first request on every daemon<->client connection. The client declares the proto/ contract version it speaks; the daemon accepts it or fails with error 1000 (protocol_version_unsupported) carrying both versions.

peerInfo.description: Identification of one side of the connection, for logs and diagnostics.

protocolVersion.description: The proto/ contract version the client speaks. Current version: 1.
The negotiated contract version both sides operate under.
